### `DELETE /api/v1/library/account/delete` / `POST /api/v1/library/account/delete`
**Controller:** `LibraryAuthController@deleteAccount`
**Auth:** `auth:library_api`, `library.owner` (library owner only — staff gets 403), `api_key`, `throttle:5,1`

Permanently soft-deletes the library account, all its branches, all its learners, all learner plan details, and all staff accounts. Revokes all active Sanctum tokens and device push tokens across all devices immediately. Prevents any future login (Web & App) and stops any scheduled cron jobs from processing the library or its learners.

**Request payload**
| Field | Type | Required | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| password | string | yes | Current password of the library owner for confirmation |
| reason | string | no | max:500 — optional reason for account deletion |

**Response (Success — 200 OK)**
| Field | Type | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| status | boolean | `true` |
| message | string | `"Your library account, branches, learners, and all active sessions have been deleted successfully."` |

**Response (Invalid Password — 422 Unprocessable Entity)**
| Field | Type | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| status | boolean | `false` |
| message | string | `"Incorrect password. Account deletion aborted."` |

### `GET /api/v1/library/profile`
**Controller:** `LibraryAuthController@profile`
**Auth:** `auth:library_api,library_user_api`, `library_user.active` (see note below), `api_key`, `throttle:60,1`

**Request payload**
| Field | Type | Required | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| None — no request body | | | |

**Response**
| Field | Type | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| status | boolean | |
| message | string | |
| data.user_id | integer | library id for a Library, library_user id for a LibraryUser |
| data.name | string | library_owner for a Library, name for a LibraryUser |
| data.user_type | integer | 1=library, 2=library_user |
| data.email | string | |
| data.mobile | string | library_mobile for a Library, mobile for a LibraryUser |
| data.library_id | integer | |
| data.library_name | string | |
| data.qr_key | string | encrypted key format: `LIBRARO-{LibraryName}-LEARNER-{LibraryNumber}=Attendance=*-` |

| data.allowed_branch[].id | integer | |
| data.allowed_branch[].name | string | |
| data.status | string | enum: Active\|Inactive, from `libraries.status` / `library_users.status` |

**Note — inactive library_user accounts:** the `library_user.active` middleware runs on every route in this authenticated group (`auth:library_api,library_user_api`), not just this one. If the authenticated user is a `LibraryUser` with `status = 0`, their current Sanctum token is revoked and the request short-circuits with `401 {"status":false,"message":"Unauthenticated."}` before reaching the controller — deactivating a staff member takes effect immediately, not just on their next login.

App equivalent of the web Monthly Revenue Report (`GET /library/monthly/payment/collection`, `ReportController@monthlyPaymentCollection` web controller / `resources/views/report/monthly_payment_collection.blade.php`). | page | integer | No | nullable; min:1; default 1 (paginates `data.report`, i.e. date groups, not individual transactions) |
